admissibility_gates: All nine frozen pairs are nonempty and remain balanced three per verification tier.
Each pair carries the same claim, vantage, and tier in both arms.
Every finite result is filed with no post-count exclusions.

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts; item bytes frozen before tokenisation

population.description: Nine fresh operational claims, balanced three each across re-derivable, witnessed, and testimony tiers

estimand.baseline: Shortest natural careful-English sentence carrying the same claim, vantage, and verification tier
estimand.aggregation: Mean token delta per tokenizer across nine equal-weight pairs; report the least-favourable (numerically largest) tokenizer mean

manifest.method: Fresh-item settlement replication of 5328fd42. Items and tier balance were frozen before tokenizer calls. For each tokenizer and pair compute tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english), average across all nine pairs, and file the numerically largest tokenizer mean as value with the full tokenizer range and per-member results. No items or tokenizers are excluded after inspection; file every finite result regardless of sign.
